# QukTik

> QukTik is a free, high-speed web utility designed to download TikTok and Douyin media without watermarks in pristine 1080p MP4 quality, extract 320kbps MP3 audio tracks, and save full-resolution photo carousels.

## Core Capabilities
- **TikTok Video Downloader Without Watermark**: Strips dynamic TikTok logos, author badges, and ending bounce cards, returning clean 1080p Full HD MP4 files.
- **TikTok to MP3 Converter**: Demuxes original high-fidelity audio streams into 320kbps MP3 sound files for offline listening, sound design, and phone ringtones.
- **TikTok Photo & Carousel Downloader**: Extracts all individual slides from TikTok image slideshows in lossless JPG format with original accompanying music.
- **TikTok Story Saver**: Archives 24-hour disappearing ephemeral TikTok stories anonymously without alerting the creator.
- **Douyin Video Downloader (抖音下载)**: Built-in Chinese text regex parser that isolates short URLs from Chinese clipboard shares and downloads unwatermarked Douyin videos.
- **TikTok Ringtone Maker**: Converts viral soundbites and dialogue into iOS (.m4r) and Android (.mp3) ringtones and alarms.
- **TikTok Avatar Downloader**: Bypasses client-side circular masks to reveal and download 1080p square profile pictures (PFPs).

## Technical & Privacy Architecture
- No Registration: No account, login, or personal credentials required.
- Zero Digital Footprint: Video URLs are processed in memory and never indexed against user IP addresses.
- Multi-CDN Failover: Automatic mirror switching (Server 1 Fast CDN, Server 2 HD Mirror) ensures 99.9% uptime.
- Client Independence: 100% web-based; works across iOS Safari, Android Chrome, Windows, macOS, and Linux without apps or extensions.
